title: How Vodafone and Borussia Dortmund brought football history to life
summary: Discover how Vodafone and Borussia Dortmund used AI and eyewitness accounts to recreate the first-ever Bundesliga goal, unseen for 63 years.

scored in Germany's top football league,

On 24 August 1963, Borussia Dortmund forward Timo Konietzka made football history at Bremen’s Weser Stadium. Just seconds into the league’s opening match against SV Werder Bremen, he put his team 1–0 ahead


, in front


of 35,000 spectators, scoring the very first goal in the newly formed Bundesliga.


It was a landmark moment for German football, but one that no camera captured.


So, Vodafone’s


AI experts


set out to recreate


the


moment


,


relying


on fragmented evidence and the


accounts


of those who experienced it.


C


ombining human insight with AI, they aimed to make this lost piece of football history visible for the first time.


In partnership with Borussia Dortmund,


our


teams spent several months analysing archival material, media


reports


and match data to help piece together the events leading up to the moment.


The team also spoke to eyewitnesses and people close to the story, including BVB historian Gerd Kolbe, Günther Konietzka, the scorer’s brother, and fan club


chairman


Eugen Kraas, to incorporate their


personal


experiences


into the reconstruction.


Human input remained essential throughout the process. Borussia Dortmund’s under-19 team reenacted the goal and the sequence of play leading up to it, providing the movement and detail needed for a lifelike recreation. Using these data points, Vodafone’s AI experts then guided multiple intelligent models to analyse the information and generate the imagery, gradually bringing the video to life.


The result is “The Unseen Goal


”,


a recreation that allows football fans to


ex


per


ience


Konietzka’s


landmark moment through moving images and sound for the first time. It fills a gap in German football and preserves the memories of those who


witnessed


it


.


Using curiosity,


creativity


and technology to turn ambitious ideas into real-world impact is the kind of innovation Vodafone pursues every day.
